feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Drought, fire and high diesel prices 'addin' up tough' for Oregon ranchers
entry.summary: Record diesel prices are kicking Western ranchers while they're down. Drought means they have to buy extra hay, and pay truckers extra to deliver it because of fuel price hikes.

entry.title: Archdiocese of New York agrees to $800 million settlement over sexual abuse claims
entry.summary: The 1,300 survivors of sexual abuse by clergy members and lay workers have all agreed to the settlement, according to an attorney for some of the plaintiffs.

entry.title: Trade tariffs cause whiplash at Port Milwaukee
entry.summary: Sacha Pfeiffer visits Port Milwaukee to see how President Trump's tariffs have affected the flow of goods and impacted the regional economy.

entry.title: How data centers became a bipartisan political issue in Wisconsin
entry.summary: Data centers are a big issue across the country. As midterms approach, many look to the swing state of Wisconsin for lessons for how that issue could play out nationally.

entry.title: Ukraine says Starlink is back to normal after disruptions
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that normal Starlink operating speeds were restored after more than a week of disruptions.

entry.title: Perspective: The next James Bond
entry.summary: A new James Bond is nigh, to replace the last actor in the 64 year-old movie franchise. What evil forces will the new 007 face? Killer Drones? Killer AI? Killer lettuce?

entry.title: Gunmen open fire at a church during a funeral in Jordan, killing 7 and wounding 40
entry.summary: Footage broadcast on Jordanian state television showed three gunmen firing shots at a Greek Orthodox church in the city of Karak on Friday.

entry.title: Is your Medicare Advantage plan ending next year? Here's what to know
entry.summary: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7, and for as many as 5 million seniors, it will be important to log on and pick a new plan.

entry.title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
entry.summary: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop would have been greater, but women over age 30 are having more children.

entry.title: This decade has been missing its big-impact midterm
entry.summary: Every other decade over the past hundred years has produced at least one midterm that made a big difference in Congress and in national politics more broadly.
